SELECT c.FirstName, SUM(ii.Quantity * ii.UnitPrice) as amount_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices inv ON c.CustomerId = inv.CustomerId
JOIN invoice_items ii ON inv.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums alb ON t.AlbumId = alb.AlbumId
JOIN artists a ON alb.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
